rules.duplicates: different index sequences remain observationally indistinguishable
rules.empty_optimum: one empty index pairing when maximum length is zero
rules.integer_serialization: path counts and fraction components are exact decimal strings
rules.pages: complete parent cohort; counts never pooled into a joint physical distribution
rules.support: exact through-pair count divided by total; no selected witness
rules.unit: distinct maximum ordered sequences of equal projected-string index pairs
rules.weighting: each distinct maximum index pairing counted once; not physical-row probability
